home:streak.days: {count, plural, =0 {No streak yet} one {# day streak} other {# day streak}}
home:streak.days__note: ICU plural — Swedish and German need forms English does not have.
home:goal.progress__note: The user's daily goal, in lessons rather than minutes — lessons are the unit they actually experience. Both are whole numbers. Never framed as falling behind.
home:goal.met: {count, plural, one {# lesson today — goal met} other {# lessons today — goal met}}
home:goal.met__note: Shown once the daily goal is reached. Congratulates without telling the user to stop; passing the goal is a good thing, not an end.
home:quest.today__note: Card title on Home for the day's quest. Max 18 chars.
home:friends.online: {count, plural, =0 {No friends online} one {# friend online} other {# friends online}}
home:friends.online__note: Count of friends currently online. ICU plural.
home:progress.mastered__note: Label on the mastery progress bar. Max 18 chars.
home:level__note: Label on the XP bar. {level} is a whole number.
home:stats.label: Your progress
home:stats.label__note: Accessibility label grouping the stats card into one element.
home:stats.xp__note: Accessibility label for the XP chip. Spoken, so a full phrase.
home:stats.coins__note: Accessibility label for the coin chip.
home:greeting.morning__note: Salutation line 1. The role follows on line 2.
home:greeting.role__note: Line 2 of the greeting. The user's role, not their name.
home:streak.label: Day streak
home:streak.label__note: Caption under the streak count. Max 12 chars.
home:avatar.label: Your profile
home:avatar.label__note: Accessibility label for the avatar button.
home:inbox.label: Inbox
home:inbox.label__note: Accessibility label for the notifications button.
home:quest.progress__note: Label on the quest progress bar.
home:friends.title: Friends
home:friends.label: Friends
home:friends.label__note: Accessibility label grouping the friends tile.
home:league.title: League
home:league.closed__note: Shown on the Home league tile while Leagues are unbuilt (v2.0). Deliberately carries NO date and no teaser — a promise with a month attached is a promise to break. It replaced an em-dash, which is a missing value rather than an empty state. Max 16 characters.
home:league.label: League standing
home:league.label__note: Accessibility label grouping the league tile.
home:world.title: Your world
home:world.title__note: Card title on Home summarising overall progress. Max 16 characters.
home:world.label: Your world progress
home:world.label__note: Accessibility label grouping the Home world card.
home:world.countries__note: Countries FINISHED (every quizzable fact mastered) out of those the packs contain. Whole numbers.
home:world.facts__note: Label on the Home world progress bar, and what a screen reader announces as its value. Counts facts, not countries, so the bar moves every session.
home:world.due: {count, plural, one {# fact ready to review} other {# facts ready to review}}
home:world.due__note: Shown only when at least one fact is due. ICU plural. "Ready to review" rather than "overdue" or "waiting" — a spaced-repetition prompt must never read as a debt the user has fallen behind on.
home:world.open__note: The row at the foot of the Home world card, opening the continents grid. It was "Explore" while it was a small button squeezed into the card's padding; as a full-width row there is space to say what it opens, and a row labelled with one word next to a chevron makes the reader guess. Max 22 characters.
home:quest.play__note: Title on Home's quest card while the quest is unfinished. The card LABEL above it already says "Today's Quest", so this says what to do rather than repeating the name. Max 34 characters.
home:quest.done__note: Replaces the title once all five tasks are finished. A statement, not a celebration — the lesson summary already celebrated. Max 20 characters.
home:quest.doneBody: Your streak is safe. Keep going if you want more.
home:quest.doneBody__note: The bar's label once the quest is done. Says the day's obligation is discharged AND that more is optional — finishing has to be enough. Max 60 characters.
home:quest.more__note: Secondary button shown only after the quest is complete, for someone who wants another lesson. Deliberately not a second primary action. Max 20 characters.
